summary: CHANGE_APPLIED (in progress): MB-004 Project Foreman module started. ROUND SUMMARY (MB-004 in progress, NOT complete). Landed so far, all uncommitted: plan.mjs, failure.mjs and discovery.mjs ported by this host and PROVEN by the donor's own engineering-plan.test.js (32/32, only import specifiers rewritten); plus checkpoint, recovery-schema, recovery-store, locking, mutation, repository, process-identity, verifier, result, git, cross-volume-cleanup, correction and failure-recovery from three parallel port agents. 16 of 22 donor modules present. THREE OPEN ITEMS: (1) adapters.mjs missing - port delegated - and its absence is the critical blocker because discovery.mjs degrades to an empty operations table and drops every command-bearing plan step; (2) supervisor.mjs, process.mjs and index.mjs unported; (3) city/test-all.mjs has 6 failures inside the port agents' in-progress files, theirs to close. NEXT: close the three, run the gates, capture consumption evidence, write the City report, push and record completion.

TEST_FAIL then REPAIR_APPLIED: the census-fragile root capability tests broke for the THIRD time. tests/capability-registry.test.mjs used m.districts[0] and m.districts[2] with an absolute unbridged count of 1; tests/capability-adapters.test.mjs used manifest.districts[0] with catalog.length===6 and 5 AVAILABLE. Declaring the new 02-engineering/01-project-foreman building changed the census and three root tests failed again, exactly as on MB-002 and MB-005. FIX: both fixtures are now census-relative (districts.at(-1), baseline-relative counts, added entries matched by capabilityId suffix). ROOT CAUSE: the same repair has now been written independently on three mission branches because each was branched from c7ef3cd and the fix never landed on main; whichever Mission merges first carries it and the other two duplicate it. TOOLING GAP: city/manifest.mjs checkManifestAgainstTree never flags an undeclared module DIRECTORY, so the census cannot detect one. After the fix pnpm test is 58/58.

ROUND SUMMARY (MB-004 near-complete, NOT complete). All 25 donor modules ported plus index.mjs (59 exports) and DONOR.json. Repaired the census-fragile root tests for the third time. REMAINING: City report, push, CI, migration_complete.

Real engineering-job run, phase 1 of scripts/mb004-foreman-pilot.mjs. A real scratch git repository with a genuinely failing node:test suite was driven through the ported entry point with the real process supervisor, real git fingerprint, real lock, real mutation journal and real result gate. Result COMPLETED, validation verdict COMPLETED, six steps, patch applied to the real file on disk, the real suite exits 0 afterwards, five checkpoints written, and the phase trail is INITIALIZING-DISCOVERING-PLANNING-TESTING-EDITING-TESTING-VERIFYING. No unit test was substituted for this run.

Real controlled interruption and recovery, phases 2 and 3. Graceful cancel: result CANCELLED at step 2, a readable checkpoint with a plan cursor survives, the workspace lock is left behind, and resuming that terminal episode is refused with a terminal episode cannot be made active by a checkpoint write. Process kill: the pilot killed a LIVE episode whose own checkpoint had already verified template:reproduce:1 and template:patch:3; the kill left a stale lock. Resuming from that checkpoint with the original episode id and an explicit stealStaleLock completed the job in FOUR steps versus SIX for a full run, and its phase trail skips the EDITING transition because the patch was already done. That is continuation, not restart.

Verification gate clause NOT EXERCISED, recorded rather than faked. The gate says the real job must go through the MB-003 Worker Gateway. MB-003s gateway modules (provider-adapter, provider-resilience, worker-task-contract) exist only on origin/mission/MB-003-worker-gateway; MB-003 is not on main, its verification was claimed by Mech and is unfinished, and rule 5 forbids Alien from touching MB-003. The port has ZERO coupling to it: the module imports only node builtins and relative .mjs files, and the gateway supplies provider runtimes while the Foreman executes through its own process.mjs. Routing a job through the gateway would therefore require authoring glue that neither donor has, which MODE=MIGRATION_ONLY forbids. Decision recorded: satisfy the clauses substance with the real run above, do not fabricate the routing, and flag the clause to the Owner.

Isolation and completion gate verified by running, not by reading. Ownership: with the user mid-edit on the very file the contract patches, the episode ended REFUSED with reasons the required tests did not pass and an unresolved critical failure remains, and the users uncommitted bytes were preserved exactly. Completion gate: result.mjs emits only COMPLETED or REFUSED, matching donor result.cjs line for line, so no FAILED verdict was introduced and a job that cannot prove itself is not allowed to claim success. Both were observed in the real runs of scripts/mb004-foreman-pilot.mjs.
